item.text:
Final confirmation done; nothing further fits in the remaining budget.

**Verified at handoff:** all three implementation source trees are byte-identical to the read-only capture (`omnipaxos/src`, `omnipaxos_runtime/src`, `omnipaxos_storage/src`); the report is 1058 lines; five `audit_*` test files and 65 logs under `notes/`.

**The audit's result** — [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-16_23-10-28-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md), reproducible end-to-end with [repro.sh](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-16_23-10-28-omnipaxos-baseline/work/repro.sh) in ~15 seconds:

- **Finding 1** — `append_notify` can resolve with a different entry's decided index, before its own entry is even accepted (runtime batching bookkeeping). Six deterministic repros, a randomised soak where 63–75 of 120 calls return a wrong index, two controls; a candidate fix takes the file to 8/8 with the captured suite still green.
- **Finding 2** — subscriptions starting below `compacted_idx` re-deliver the collapsed prefix once per tick and re-deliver decided entries, because the cursor counts items rather than log positions. Two repros; the cursor fix passes them and coexists with finding 1's fix.
- **Finding 3 (narrowed)** — a lagging follower isn't rebuilt by the protocol itself and a re-sent `Decide` reuses an already-consumed counter so it cannot take effect. Source-confirmed and trace-observed, but the deterministic probe turned out to model a dead link and my leader-side fix was refuted by execution, so it is reported as an observation with its limits, not a defect.
- **Finding 4** — both bundled storages violate the documented `Storage` rule for a partially materialised interval: `PersistentStorage` returns an opaque error (executed against RocksDB), `MemoryStorage` subtracts `trimmed_idx` (usize underflow). Core-level reachability not demonstrated.

Alongside them: the negative-result set (crash-recovery `#[ignore]`d tests pass when run, stale-leader adoption, a 4000-round partition/churn soak, the StopSign boundary, load-stability of the captured runtime suite), evidence-base caveats, a prioritised open list, and a per-finding verification map so any individual claim can be checked in under a minute.
